claims.name: install-present
claims.risk: the report says OutcomeBound is set up, yet the project holds no install manifest

claims.name: done-run-and-reported
claims.risk: the install is not followed by a successful run of the Done commands, or the answer does not report its result

claims.name: signals-cited-or-absent
claims.risk: the project's instruction text states a fact about the generated file, the migrations or the CI secret without the file that shows it

claims.name: no-invented-path
claims.risk: the project's instruction text names a path that the project does not hold

claims.name: no-overview-prose
claims.risk: the run added a generic overview, architecture or directory-tree section to the project's instruction text
